notes: Re-written 2026-11-23 against the current code (wave-15 test was removed for reaching getModelFieldsForType, fixed by feature 20261120-161825-core-blocker-fixes). Covers hand-built rules (and/or/parentheses, empty rule, two-digit index x(12) with 12 genes), replacement of an existing rxnGeneMat, grRules-only with all genes known (generateRules), grRules-only with a gene not in genes (generateRules warns and calls addGenes -> getModelFieldsForType, the formerly quarantined path; now passes), neither rules nor grRules, no genes (nRxns x 0), and E. coli core (getDistributedModel, once): rebuilt pattern equals the stored one. The generateRules call depends on the input (absent rules with grRules), so it is not an extra edge; generateRules already has a test. Line 39 (isfield rules) is always true after lines 27-36 but is executed, so no exemption. One warning surfaces by design (generateRules, new gene gD). Passed with 11/11 lines.

defects.title: metabolite identifiers written with a \u escape are not found
defects.trigger: metabolite id with a non-ASCII character written by json.dump (ensure_ascii, cobrapy default) as a \u escape, e.g. {"metabolites":[{"id":"A\u00e9"},{"id":"B"}],"reactions":[{"id":"R1","metabolites":{"A\u00e9":-1,"B":1},"lower_bound":0,"upper_bound":1}]}
defects.observed: error 'Metabolite Au00e9 of reaction R1 is not defined in the model.' (line 110): jsondecode decodes the id to A+char(233), line 106 only drops the backslash
defects.expected: model read with S = [-1; 1] (help NOTE: ids kept as written)

defects.title: a metabolite identifier containing a brace makes the reaction stoichiometry unreadable
defects.observed: error 'The number of reaction stoichiometries (0) differs from the number of reactions (1).': the pattern of line 96 excludes braces inside a metabolites object

defects.title: an empty model cannot be read
defects.observed: error 'Input #2 expected to be a cell array, was double instead.' at line 62: jsondecode returns [] (double), neither struct nor cell
defects.expected: a model with no metabolites, reactions or genes

notes: Re-written 2026-11-23 against the current code (wave-15 test removed for reaching getModelFieldsForType via generateRules -> addGenes; fixed). Own test per III-Naming; the shared older test testReadPythonFiles.m (four functions) is unchanged. Covers heterogeneous objects (cell arrays) and homogeneous ones (struct arrays) for metabolites, reactions and genes; present/empty/null/absent attributes; escapes \/ and \" in ids; empty stoichiometry object; genes absent/empty; a rule naming an unlisted gene (generateRules printLevel 0 adds it; formerly quarantined path, now passes); string file name; printLevel 1; four own errors with exact messages plus two inputParser refusals. Three limitation defects (inputs skipped, no lines left uncovered), reproduced in MATLAB R2025a with: d=tempname; mkdir(d); f=fullfile(d,'m.json'); fid=fopen(f,'w'); fprintf(fid,'%s',<trigger text, backslash as char(92)>); fclose(fid); readCobrapyJSONModel(f). Severity is a judgement: the \u case is a valid cobrapy file (non-ASCII metabolite ids) and the function fails loudly; classed limitation (unsupported, rare: SBML ids are ASCII) rather than error, which would re-quarantine it and loadEcosystemScenario. Contrived variant not tested: ids 'A\u00e9' and 'Au00e9' both present would map the first's coefficients to the second silently. generateRules is called only when some grRules is non-empty (input-dependent, already tested), so no extra edge. The first coverage run failed (csense is a column) and left a tempdir leftover from that failed run; the final run passed with no leftover. Lead 2026-11-23: graded error, not limitation, by research R5 consistency rule (a valid cobrapy file, the documented input, stops the call); converted to the quarantine layout; the passing full test is kept in inventory/review/quarantined-full-tests/testReadCobrapyJSONModel.m.
